label: Figma
description: Read Figma design files and manage file comments through the Figma REST API.
notes: All three piece actions are thin single-request wrappers and transpiled 1:1. The piece's generic custom-API-call action was skipped (covered by Agently's generic HTTP node). The new_comment webhook trigger was skipped per rules (webhook registration lifecycle + context.store). AP OAuth2 auth mapped to FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN; Figma also accepts personal access tokens as Bearer tokens on these endpoints.
